notes.title: Big Achievements Update! Build v1.0.8 is live now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37561839/49261528d5afb17931db65d790cf1813642fe1b2.png

Ready to achieve even more? When BattleCakes first launched we had a mere four Achievements and now we've updated and expanded to sixteen. Neat! Do four times the achievements mean four times the fun? Gosh, we hope so. In addition, this build has an assortment of fixes and updates... but the Achievements is the fun bit...

Major Bug Fixes:

 Fixed bug preventing re-match with Butterscreams if defeated during encounter.

Additional Updates and Smaller Fixes:

 More cats!
 Added floating number UI when heroes hit by world hazards
 Fixed bug where corner HUD health meter didn't update after Health pickups.
 Misc collider fixes in West Garnish region
 Misc art updates for Nougat Hollow region
 Various copy edits to fix dialogue typos.

notes.title: UPDATE: West Garnish update delayed
notes.notes:
UPDATE: Apologies, everyone. This week's West Garnish content update is going to be delayed. Our team found a game breaking issue and we are working hard to get it resolved ASAP!

Thank you for your patience and understanding!

notes.title: Content Update Coming Soon and Early Access Discount Price Ending
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37561839/584724efbc48b6e007ce22088553469e16c9b523.png

We will be releasing our next big content update for BattleCakes this coming Monday, January 29th!

What to expect in the upcoming build?

In addition to the content updates which includes:

 New location! The desert town of West Garnish, the Whistling Gorge, the crystal mines and more.
 New NPCs! Meet the colorful cast of West Garnish and the visitors to the West Garnish Gemboree.
 New Dangers! Delve into the crystal mines of the West Garnish Dungeon and continue your pursuit of Lord Fondant.

There will also be:

 Controller Re-mapping!
 Updated default keyboard controls
 Quest UI improvements
 Save Slot UI improvements
 And more...

Please note: With the upcoming build, we will also be ending the discounted Early Access pricing and the game will go up to the full release price of $19.99 (USD).

Thank you to all our players and can't wait to hear what you think of the next area! There's only one more town to go after this one and then the final battle awaits! We're getting closer and closer to release, so please share your thoughts and feedback! We appreciate you! 🙂

notes.title: Build v0.9.0 live now - The Magic and Menace Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37561839/0e81e0c9c685a297bd754d674eac1f0210f8a6ff.png

Hello, everyone! We’re so excited to have another build for you, this time continuing into the Marzipan dungeon and the many dangers that await! We had more work than expected in terms of bug fixes and some system improvements that needed to happen, so thank you all for your patience and continued feedback. It is a huge help and we appreciate you all so much!

What’s new in Build v0.9.0:

 Marzipan dungeon levels unlocked, including the Trail of Might, Trial of Moxie and boss battle with the Gummy Wyrm.
 Updated Gummy Beast and Gummy Wyrm reflect actions with more obvious particle effects and visible icons.
 Refactored level-up UI to make sure Stat Increase and Action upgrade choices are presented directly to player post-encounter.
 Added stat increases for visiting with willow shrines on MZ Bridge.
 Added potential stat increase for completing Leena Moonberry quiz.
 Additional forest region and waterfall when leaving Marzipan.
 Short river run mini-game.
 A small glimpse of West Garnish.

Major Bug Fixes:

 Fixed game breaking bug in Honeybun Queen encounter with certain encounter end conditions.
 Fixed conversation position in BH Theater trapping player.
 Fixed BH Town bush colliders when placed too close to buildings, trapping player.
 Fixed Midnite Truffle’s Blacklight Vortex action, bad animation call breaks game.

Additional Updates and Smaller Fixes:

 Made status numbers and text more clear during encounters.
 Fixed road colliders near Butterworth Heights wagon crossroads.
 Fixed colliders and sorting for Creamhorns and cheeps in BH.
 Fixed dialogue balloon positions for Honeybun Queen.
 Fixed dialogue balloon positions for Leena during quiz sequence.
 Added additional background NPCs and dialogue updates in MZ University

notes.title: Content update coming Monday, November 13th!
notes.notes:
We will be releasing the first big content update for BattleCakes this coming Monday, November 13th! Thank you to everyone who has played so far and we can't wait for you to see the new areas of the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37561839/2c50f4403486a454abe014b70bc061702e6dbfaa.gif

What to expect in the upcoming build?

 New locations! Including the mountain town of Marzipan, the magical Marzipan University and the outskirts of the Marzipan wilds.
 New NPCs! Including the tourists and townspeople of Marzipan and the students and staff of Marzipan University. 
 New critters! Including the squish-tastic Gummy Beasts and the guardian Constructs of the Marzipan ruins.

notes.title: Build v0.7.5 live now - scene change and camera bug fixes
notes.notes:
Major bug fixes:

 Fixed scene change bug where party's initial scene position would be at last save point instead of intended starting door.
 Fixed post-DeLeche encounter dialogue stealing camera position when heroes Defeated.
 Fixed save game Delete confirmation screen not closing poperly when back button pressed on controller.

Additional updates:

 Re-enabled and animated slide-in of Action Name display during encounters.
 Added additional toppers, items and misc action updates.
 Count DeLeche animations updates.
 Fixed BH Inn Keeper rest dialogue.

notes.title: Build v.0.7.2 live now - save/load bugfix and other updates
notes.notes:
Major bug fix:

 Save/load functionality was breaking due to crafting-related bug after Crafting with Taffeta at farm. Crafting code updated and bug resolved.

Additional smaller updates:

 Fixed bug where SubAlert is sometimes destroyed before animate offscreen is finished.
 Added error validation for interacts to prevent errors when no items received.
 Removed unused phones from bus stop art now that phone saves are separate.
 Clarified town directions in VH bus stop scene.
 Added new Wayfinder interact posts for town direction reminders, etc.
 Updated basic repeating grass texture.
 Updated shopkeeper art in Butterworth Heights town.
 Fixed Farmer Hazel’s idle animation
